title: operator_signature empty-until-wired references opaque issue ID in comment
description: core/ipld/root_node.rs:68 and core/ipld/metadata.rs:104: comment says 'Empty until signing is wired in (l62.2.6)'. The issue reference assumes reader has access to the project tracker. The field is structurally always-empty for now but the type is Vec<u8>, which does not express unsigned-ness. Fix: replace external reference with inline explanation; consider Option<Vec<u8>> to express None=unsigned at the type level so callers cannot accidentally treat empty vec as a valid signature.
